title: Lap timer
description: A pixel lap timer: Start/Stop toggles a running time shown as mm:ss.t, Lap records the current time in a numbered list with the newest first, the fastest lap is highlighted, and Reset clears everything.

title: Vending machine
description: A pixel vending machine with 4 snacks priced 1.25, 1.50, 0.75 and 2.00: Insert 0.25 and Insert 1.00 buttons add credit, clicking a snack you can afford dispenses it and shows the change, otherwise it shows 'Not enough credit'.

title: Word chain
description: A pixel word chain game: type a word whose first letter is the last letter of the previous word (starting from 'pixel'), repeated words are rejected with 'Already used', and a counter shows the chain length.

title: Candle timer
description: A pixel candle that burns for 3 minutes: Light starts it, the candle's height shrinks as time passes, Blow out pauses it, the remaining time shows as m:ss, and 'Burnt out' appears at zero.

title: Pizza builder
description: A pixel pizza order: choose Small (8), Medium (10) or Large (12) and toggle up to 5 toppings at 1.50 each, the total updates live, a sixth topping is refused with 'Max 5 toppings', and Order shows a summary.

title: Mini sudoku
description: A pixel 4x4 sudoku with a built-in puzzle: empty cells take digits 1-4, a cell that repeats a digit in its row, column or 2x2 box turns red, and 'Solved!' appears when the grid is full and valid.

title: Traffic counter
description: A pixel traffic counter with Car, Bus and Bike buttons: each click adds one to that type, a total and each type's percentage of the total are shown, and Undo removes the last click.

title: Workout rest timer
description: A pixel workout timer: 3 sets of 40 seconds work and 20 seconds rest, the current phase (Work or Rest) and set number are shown with a countdown, Skip moves to the next phase, and 'Workout complete' appears at the end.
